_note: Inputs of jenga-scan-plan. tower: teammate's tower_pose.yaml / tower_nominal.json (world frame, z0 = tower base). dino: Dino tip pose in the hand frame (ah?_base_link) = GUESS until measured: axis from the pick pose (Dino hangs tip-down in the jig), tip point not measured.

tower._layer_h_note: 0.02186 from the 2026-10-30 check: taught L13 shots on +x were 6 mm lower than with 0.02236 (teammate value), relative to the L01 calibration
tower._jenga_tf_note: jenga_tf block_size height (jenga_perception tower/jenga_tf.py): the nominal the pull planner uses; the order JSON reports rise_residual_mm against it

dino._tool_note: tool_hand: Dino frame in the hand frame from jenga-calib (origin = point in focus, z = optical axis, y = image down). A missing arm uses the other one mirrored. tip_to_focus_m: Dino tip behind the focus point (measured at dial 30, only for the sim clearance).
dino._mode_note: 2026-11-20: the Dino picked out of its holder for every run (pick_dino_th / place_dino_th), as before the hand jig: tool and calibration of 2026-10-30 (config/scan_setup.json.bak_20261118_before_jig). hand_pose: the grasp, only for the tower clearance. The jig's Dino is kept as dino_jig (`jenga_autoscan dino jig` switches back).

right._note: 2026-11-18 scan hand pose jig_scan_pose (Dino straight out of the hand), dial 40, taught px_col_mid; left/right taught poses agree within 0.3 mm in depth and height. image_tilt_deg from captures/20261118_140800_698.png

dino_jig._tool_note: tool_hand: Dino frame in the hand frame from jenga-calib (origin = point in focus, z = optical axis, y = image down). A missing arm uses the other one mirrored. tip_to_focus_m: Dino tip behind the focus point (measured at dial 30, only for the sim clearance).
dino_jig._upside_down_note: 2026-11-18 hand jig: the Dino sits turned 180 deg, camera.DinoCamera turns every frame back

_roll_note: roll_deg = where the hand sits around the Dino axis (per arm). Chosen by reachability 2026-10-29: right 270 covers -y and +x, left 90 covers -x and +y. The image then is rotated by a multiple of 90 deg: rotate it in software (image_rotate, to be set at the first real shot).
_jig_note: jig_y: world y of the Dino jig centre (m). 0 = robot centre line (assumed, NOT measured); left pick poses = right ones mirrored and shifted by 2*jig_y.
_jig_run_note: 2026-11-18 scan hand pose: straight view (view_yaw 0), +x from/to jig_ready_1118 (px_col_mid 120 mm back along the lens). Model clearance: wrist joints >= 41 mm, arm >= 65 mm
